remediation: Apply POL-04 4.5 to every new tool

gap: 8 controls planned and 28 partial

control_description: Technology controls for SaaS inherited from vendors; OT controls by the cooperative
gap: Complementary user entity controls for SCADA (named accounts, MFA, removal, log review) not in place

gap: Account and termination procedures due 2026-09-30

control_description: MFA on the business suite and email; SCADA shared login without MFA; AMI without MFA

control_description: Accounts created on verbal request
gap: No approval or onboarding process

control_description: Rights not reviewed; AMI disconnect rights for 4 users
gap: No review; least privilege not applied

gap: Keys untracked; locks not changed after a departure

control_description: Office devices wiped by the MSP before reuse; no rule for replaced field devices
gap: Replaced recloser controls and modems not reset before disposal

gap: Public-IP modems and standing vendor access (LR-4 finding)

control_description: No vulnerability scanning; no firmware tracking
gap: Field device flaws never identified

control_description: SCADA operational alarms only; no sign-in alerts or log review
gap: No security monitoring

gap: No records yet

control_description: ERP for storms; cyber insurance; manual operation of every device
